leaseRenewalProcedure.purpose: Same-identity renewal of the SECONDARY sending lease so a fresh worker or the owner can repeat it from the repository alone.
leaseRenewalProcedure.where: The central Mission Control service on the PRIMARY host: container mission-control-issue90-live, image codex-mission-control:claude-integrator-22ef1a5, host network, data volume codex-mission-control-issue90-live-v2, started from a root-only env file under /etc/mission-control/ named for that image.
steps: Check preconditions: the live container is healthy, its image and mounts are unchanged, and its env file still matches the running environment (compare digests only; never print values).

Copy the env file. In the copy change only the expiresAt field of MISSION_CONTROL_SUBMISSION_ACTIVE_LEASE_JSON (now 2026-09-27T00:00:00.000Z; schemaVersion 1, epoch 6, role SECONDARY, SINGLE_ACTIVE_CONFIRMED) to the new expiry. Every other line and every other lease field, including leaseId and issuedAt, stays byte-identical.
Stop the live container and keep it, renamed, as the rollback copy. Start a new container from the same image with the same network, volumes and read-only mounts and the renewed env file.
Wait for the healthcheck. If it does not pass, stop the new container and restart the renamed original.

Verify that the central /health and the relay's central status report ACTIVE_LEASE with the new leaseExpiresAt and the same epoch. The lease is read at service startup (lib/submission-authority-runtime.ts), so the brief restart is required.
leaseRenewalProcedure.ownerRunForm: A prepared script implementing exactly these steps, with automatic rollback (central-lease-renew.sh <new-expiresAt>), was handed to the owner in the owner's Claude session at 2026-09-26T18:26Z, together with the exact command and the 00:00Z deadline.
leaseRenewalProcedure.whyOwnerRun: The assistant's execution environment refused to run it (its action-safety classifier), because the renewal rewrites a root-only env file and recreates the container. No repository or owner authority is missing.
